characters.name: Balthasar Gelt
characters.arrival_description:
Our officials report that Balthasar Gelt has arrived in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. The visitor wears a golden mask and travels with the instruments of an alchemist.

Gelt is a wizard of the Gold Order, renowned for his mastery of metal and his experiments with black powder. His reputation attracts craftsmen and scholars, though stories of transmuted coins have made some merchants wary.
characters.modifier_description: A gold-masked alchemist has taken an interest in the province's furnaces, and metalworkers crowd his demonstrations of transmutation. Gelt's advice promises purer alloys and hotter forges, though merchants have begun testing every suspiciously bright coin. His experiments keep the workshops busy and the neighbors awake.

characters.name: Teclis
characters.arrival_description:
A dispatch from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] announces the arrival of Teclis. The High Elf archmage is asking after old inscriptions and places where the Winds of Magic gather.

Teclis helped Magnus the Pious resist Chaos and establish the Imperial Colleges of Magic. His frail appearance conceals a sorcerer powerful enough to have defeated Malekith at Finuval Plain.
characters.modifier_description: Teclis is examining old inscriptions and neglected wards in this province, drawing scholars eager to question the archmage who helped establish the human Colleges of Magic. Even a few words of his instruction can overturn a lifetime of study. His impatience with dangerous ignorance has already offended several local authorities.

characters.name: Deathmaster Snikch
characters.arrival_description:
Our informants in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] believe that Deathmaster Snikch has entered the province. Their reports describe a cloaked Skaven and blades carried in both paws and tail.

Snikch is Clan Eshin's most feared assassin, notorious for reaching victims behind locked doors and guarded walls. We have a warning of his presence, but neither his hiding place nor his intended victim is known.
characters.modifier_description: Reports of a shadow with three blades have sent the province's officials searching their bedchambers for hidden entrances. Clan Eshin's Deathmaster leaves few witnesses, but locked doors offer little reassurance when a body is found beyond them. Merchants pay dearly for escorts while the watch inspects every drain and roofline.

characters.name: Josef Bugman
characters.arrival_description:
Travelers in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] have identified Josef Bugman among a band of heavily armed Dwarf rangers. Their baggage includes casks whose markings have already attracted the attention of local brewers.

Bugman was a celebrated master brewer before Goblins destroyed his brewery. He and its survivors now wander in search of vengeance and missing kin, carrying what remains of his famous ale.
characters.modifier_description: Bugman's rangers have found somewhere to broach a cask, and every brewer in the province wants a taste of the master's ale. Between arguments over malt and fermentation, the Dwarfs ask after Goblin raiders and survivors of the ruined brewery. Better beer brings customers, but crossed grudges and loaded crossbows make for uneasy company.

characters.name: Bardin Goreksson
characters.arrival_description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] report the arrival of Bardin Goreksson. The Dwarf traveler has been questioning miners and studying maps of forgotten mountain roads.

Bardin served as an Ironbreaker at Karak Norn before taking up a ranger's wandering life. His great ambition is to find the lost hold of Karak Zorn, and few rumors of ancient Dwarf stonework escape his attention.
characters.modifier_description: Bardin Goreksson is questioning miners and comparing battered maps in his search for the lost hold of Karak Zorn. The former Ironbreaker has an eye for weak stonework and passages a careless sentry might miss. His tunnel excursions, booming songs, and stubborn disputes over ancient Dwarf claims have become familiar local complaints.

characters.name: Harald Hammerstorm
characters.arrival_description:
Scouts report that Harald Hammerstorm has arrived in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. The northern warrior carries the great hammer from which his name is taken.

Harald is a champion of Chaos whose reputation rests on savage feats of arms and his particular hatred of the undead. Tales of his escape from the tombs of Vorshgar claim that even the restless dead learned to fear him.
characters.modifier_description: Harald Hammerstorm's camp attracts northern warriors eager to test their strength beside the bearer of that terrible hammer. Tales of the dead recoiling before him have spread from the burial grounds to the barracks. His followers spend freely on weapons and drink, but every boast seems to end in a challenge.

characters.name: Abhorash
characters.arrival_description:
Reports from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] describe a solitary warrior whom our informants identify as Abhorash. He has shown little interest in titles or hospitality, but considerable interest in worthy opponents.

Abhorash is an ancient vampire swordsman whose pursuit of martial perfection inspired the Blood Dragons. It is said that he slew a dragon and drank its blood, freeing himself from the thirst that rules his kind.
characters.modifier_description: A solitary swordsman is testing the province's finest fighters with a discipline that makes their bravado look childish. Those who recognize Abhorash whisper of the vampire who overcame his thirst by drinking a dragon's blood. His example sharpens blades and drills alike, while rumors of his nature keep shutters closed after dusk.

characters.name: Elspeth von Draken
characters.arrival_description:
Our officials have learned that Elspeth von Draken is now in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. Requests for old burial records and sealed collections of relics first drew their attention to her arrival.

Elspeth is a reclusive Amethyst wizard associated with Nuln and the study of death magic. She travels in pursuit of arcane knowledge and guards her own secrets as fiercely as she seeks those of others.
characters.modifier_description: Elspeth von Draken has requested old burial records and access to vaults whose seals the custodians would rather leave undisturbed. Her studies of death and forgotten relics have prompted a hurried inspection of crypt doors and neglected wards. Petitioners gather outside her lodgings, but the Amethyst wizard has little patience for officials who interrupt her work.

characters.name: Markus Wulfhart
characters.arrival_description:
A report from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] places Markus Wulfhart in the province. He is gathering accounts of dangerous beasts and the tracks they leave behind.

The Empire's Huntsmarshal earned his reputation pursuing monsters, including the Drakwald Cyclops that destroyed his home. An expert archer and tracker, he leads scouts accustomed to following quarry that ordinary soldiers would rather avoid.
characters.modifier_description: Markus Wulfhart is buying reports of claw marks, missing livestock, and carcasses too large for any ordinary wolf to have dragged away. Hunters compete to join the Huntsmarshal's scouts, hoping to learn how he brought down the Drakwald Cyclops. His preparations fill workshops with orders for arrows and traps, while rumors of his quarry unsettle the countryside.

characters.name: Gotrek and Felix
characters.arrival_description:
Our officials report that Gotrek and Felix have arrived in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. Witnesses describe an orange-crested Dwarf with a formidable axe and a human swordsman carrying writing materials.

Gotrek Gurnisson is a Slayer seeking a death worthy of his oath. Felix Jaeger has sworn to accompany him and record that doom, fighting beside his companion through the dangers their travels uncover.
characters.modifier_description: Gotrek and Felix are lodging in the province, where the Slayer's search for a worthy doom has led them toward suspicious cellars and heavily barred tunnels. Felix fights beside him and records their exploits, though the innkeepers seem more interested in recording the damage. They leave battered monsters, reassured survivors, and fresh tavern quarrels wherever they go.

characters.name: Repanse de Lyonesse
characters.arrival_description:
Word from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] identifies a newly arrived knight as Repanse de Lyonesse. Her banner has been recognized by travelers familiar with Bretonnian tales.

Once a shepherdess, Repanse answered the Lady's call, rallied defeated knights, and broke the siege of Couronne. Preserved by the Lady's grace, she now travels as a champion of her faith rather than ruling from a ducal court.
characters.modifier_description: Repanse's banner has drawn pilgrims and would-be soldiers who repeat the tale of the shepherdess who rallied Bretonnia's knights and saved Couronne. Her insistence that courage matters more than birth has stirred the common folk and offended those who guard their rank. Smiths and provisioners welcome the gathering, even as local officers struggle to keep it orderly.

characters.name: Sienna Fuegonasus
characters.arrival_description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] report that Sienna Fuegonasus has arrived. The red-haired traveler has already shown a lively interest in the province's furnaces and fire pits.

Sienna is a Bright Wizard who studied under Thyrus Gormann before abandoning the restrictions of the Bright College. Her command of Aqshy is formidable, as is the fascination with flame that so often tests her restraint.
characters.modifier_description: Sienna Fuegonasus has been coaxing extraordinary heat from local furnaces, to the delight of craftsmen and the alarm of their neighbors. The Bright Wizard's fascination with Aqshy runs far beyond the patient routines her former tutors would prefer. Orders for metalwork are rising, but so are complaints about sparks, scorched roofs, and laughter from the workshop after midnight.

characters.name: Malakai Makaisson
characters.arrival_description:
A dispatch from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] records the arrival of Malakai Makaisson. The Dwarf has brought tools, sketches, and firm opinions about the shortcomings of other people's machinery.

Malakai is an engineer who took the Slayer oath after the disasters of his Unsinkable ironclad and Undestructible airship. Disgrace has done little to diminish his inventive ambition or his appetite for another experiment.
characters.modifier_description: Malakai Makaisson has filled a rented yard with gears, gun barrels, and a machine whose purpose changes with each explanation. The Slayer engineer's demonstrations attract smiths and gunners, despite whispered accounts of the Unsinkable and the Undestructible. His suggestions are improving local defenses; his test firings are doing rather less for the neighbors' peace of mind.

characters.name: Tyrion
characters.arrival_description:
Travelers have brought us word that Tyrion has arrived in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. Their descriptions of his bearing and extraordinary horsemanship agree with accounts of the High Elf champion.

A descendant of Aenarion, Tyrion is celebrated as one of Ulthuan's greatest warriors. His defeat of Urian Poisonblade at Finuval Plain is recounted wherever the struggle between the High Elves and Dark Elves is remembered.
characters.modifier_description: Word that the victor over Urian Poisonblade is passing through the province has drawn swordsmen eager to watch Tyrion train. His effortless command of horse and blade inspires recruits and leaves proud veterans demanding another bout. Armorers welcome the custom, while officers contend with wounded pride and arguments over the High Elf champion's presence.

characters.name: Gor-Rok
characters.arrival_description:
Witnesses in [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] report the arrival of a huge white Saurus bearing a battered shield. Our advisers identify the description as Gor-Rok, the Great White Lizard of Itza.

Gor-Rok is an ancient warrior renowned for standing his ground against overwhelming attacks. His campaigns have made him a formidable guardian of the Lizardmen's cities and sacred relics, though his present purpose remains unexplained.
characters.modifier_description: The Great White Lizard stands watch near ancient stones in this province, his immense shield scarred by blows that would have felled lesser warriors. Reports of Gor-Rok's unyielding defense have set soldiers inspecting their own shield walls and barricades. He offers no explanation to officials, and anyone approaching the relics he guards does so with considerable caution.

characters.name: Nakai the Wanderer
characters.arrival_description:
Reports from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] describe an enormous Kroxigor moving among old ruins. Skink travelers have identified him as Nakai the Wanderer.

Nakai is an ancient defender of the Lizardmen, remembered for holding Itza's Bridge of Stars against daemons during the Great Catastrophe. He appears where danger threatens the remnants of the Old Ones' works, then resumes his wandering without explanation.
characters.modifier_description: Enormous tracks lead toward old ruins, where witnesses report a Kroxigor looming over stones half buried by the years. Skink travelers name him Nakai, the wanderer said to have held Itza's Bridge of Stars against the daemonic host. His unexplained arrival has prompted hurried repairs to gates and barricades, while carts and crowds detour around his chosen path.

characters.name: Thanquol and Boneripper
characters.arrival_description:
Our informants report that Thanquol and Boneripper have entered [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName]. A horned Skaven and an immense Rat Ogre have been seen moving through concealed passages.

Thanquol is a Grey Seer whose sorcery, ambition, and appetite for warpstone are matched by his talent for blaming others when his schemes fail. Boneripper is the name he gives his monstrous bodyguard, whose strength supplies the persuasion his boasts cannot.
characters.modifier_description: Thanquol and Boneripper are concealed somewhere beneath the province, judging by the sudden demand for warpstone and the size of the broken doors. The Grey Seer's extravagant schemes keep smugglers busy, while his Rat Ogre bodyguard gives reluctant suppliers a reason to deliver. They leave rival informants, frightened witnesses, and unpaid accounts for the authorities to untangle.

characters.name: Grombrindal
characters.arrival_description:
Travelers from [war_adventurer_arrival_province.GetName] insist that Grombrindal has appeared there. Their accounts agree on a white-bearded Dwarf warrior, though none can explain where he came from.

The White Dwarf is a figure of ancestral legend, said to appear when his kin face their darkest hours. Stories tell of hopeless battles turned by his arrival and of a rescuer who vanishes before gratitude can catch him.
characters.modifier_description: Travelers insist that a white-bearded Dwarf has appeared wherever the province's fighting is fiercest, only to vanish before anyone can thank him. Tales of Grombrindal's impossible rescues stiffen the defenders' resolve and bring curious visitors to the taverns. They also awaken old grudges, as Dwarfs demand to know whose broken oaths required the White Dwarf's intervention.

events.title: Powder Without Smoke
events.report: Your artillery clerk reports that Gelt's overnight experiments produced a cleaner powder batch, but the guild has impounded his notes after a dispute over credit.

options.label: Recognize the engineers and adopt the method
Purchase the notes for civilian furnaces
Leave the dispute to the guild and collect its licence fee

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our artillery clerk reports that Gelt's overnight experiments produced a cleaner powder batch, but the guild has impounded his notes after a dispute over credit. A powder-blackened brass measure accompanies the clerk's letter, its rim marked with the quantities that survived the test.

Our officials ask us to recognize the engineers and adopt the method. Others argue that we should instead purchase the notes for civilian furnaces. Gelt has left his instruments packed for another journey, and the escort cannot promise to detain him.

events.title: Behind the Golden Door
events.report: A magistrate reports an explosion in a rented laboratory. Gelt rescued the apprentices and escaped behind his mask; salvagers have recovered unfamiliar refining instruments from the wreckage.
events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. A magistrate reports an explosion in a rented laboratory. Gelt rescued the apprentices and escaped behind his mask; salvagers have recovered unfamiliar refining instruments from the wreckage. The salvagers have stacked the intact retorts beside a list of broken windows and the apprentices who must be paid.

Our officials ask us to rebuild around the recovered instruments. Others argue that we should instead give them to the college. The masked alchemist has slipped away from the officials sent to demand an explanation.

events.title: The Captain's Old Claim
events.report: A river captain petitions your court over gold that became lead after Gelt paid his fare. Examination of the remaining metal reveals a useful assay technique, while the captain demands restitution.

options.label: Compensate the captain and study the sample
Broker a guild settlement and restore the landing facilities
Dismiss the claim but retain the evidence

events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. A river captain petitions our court over gold that became lead after Gelt paid his fare. Examination of the remaining metal reveals a useful assay technique, while the captain demands restitution. The captain has nailed one of the dull grey coins to his petition so that nobody can dismiss his loss as a tavern tale.

Our officials ask us to compensate the captain and study the sample. Others argue that we should instead broker a guild settlement and restore the landing facilities. The remaining attendants expect Gelt to be across the border before any summons can reach him.

events.title: A Mutiny Paid in Lead
events.report: Your treasurer reports that conspirators preparing to seize a local arsenal have lost their mercenary payroll to Gelt's transmutation. Their abandoned accounts name officials involved in the plot.

options.label: Pay the informants to map the conspiracy for our investigators

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our treasurer reports that conspirators preparing to seize a local arsenal have lost their mercenary payroll to Gelt's transmutation. Their abandoned accounts name officials involved in the plot. Several mercenary captains have surrendered their worthless advances and offered to identify the men who hired them.

Our officials ask us to prosecute the organizers. Others argue that we should instead recover their remaining assets. Gelt's latest lodgings stand empty, leaving his hosts to settle the accounts after his departure.

events.title: The Engineers' Dinner
events.report: Guild officers report that a quarrel at a banquet ended with Gelt demonstrating a safer powder measure on the dining table. He departed before the senior master could forbid its use.

options.label: Exhibit the successful demonstration in a public archive

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Guild officers report that a quarrel at a banquet ended with Gelt demonstrating a safer powder measure on the dining table.

He departed before the senior master could forbid its use. A scorched tablecloth bears the measurements, copied in wine by an apprentice before the servants cleared the hall.

Our officials ask us to authorize a public trial. Others argue that we should instead commission controlled workshop copies. No search party has persuaded the golden-masked visitor to remain for an audience.

events.title: Lead on Foreign Scales
events.report: Your customs officers intercepted counterfeit-looking gold after Gelt left a caravanserai. A local assayer found that the residue exposes adulterated imports more reliably than the existing test.

options.label: Pay affected merchants and equip a permanent assay office
Permit a private settlement and collect the agreed duties

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our customs officers intercepted counterfeit-looking gold after Gelt left a caravanserai. A local assayer found that the residue exposes adulterated imports more reliably than the existing test. The assayer has kept the suspect coins beside samples of imported metal that failed the new test.

The council proposes that we pay affected merchants and equip a permanent assay office. A second proposal would have us retain the residue for scholars. Gelt has left his instruments packed for another journey, and the escort cannot promise to detain him.

events.title: The Furnace Translator
events.report: A foreign-language notebook left by Gelt has helped local metalworkers recover ore they previously discarded. Two guilds now claim exclusive rights to the technique.

options.label: Divide access through a new system of guild permits

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. A foreign-language notebook left by Gelt has helped local metalworkers recover ore they previously discarded. Two guilds now claim exclusive rights to the technique. Workers have already separated a small pile of saleable metal from slag previously carted outside the town.

The council proposes that we publish a translation. A second proposal would have us grant a limited charter. The masked alchemist has slipped away from the officials sent to demand an explanation.

events.title: The Masked Patient
events.report: A physician reports treating apprentices after an alchemical flash in Gelt's lodgings. The wizard paid with medical reagents and vanished, leaving both useful supplies and alarming rumours about his face.

options.label: Equip local infirmaries with the reagents

events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. A physician reports treating apprentices after an alchemical flash in Gelt's lodgings. The wizard paid with medical reagents and vanished, leaving both useful supplies and alarming rumours about his face. Among the supplies are sealed burn dressings and labelled jars whose preparation the physician has carefully recorded.

The council proposes that we equip local infirmaries with the reagents. A second proposal would have us reserve them for study. The remaining attendants expect Gelt to be across the border before any summons can reach him.

events.title: A Warlord's Worthless Chest
events.report: Border traders report that Gelt turned a raider's tribute chest into lead before its owner could hire an army. Captured ledgers expose the foreign brokers supplying the raiders.

options.label: Buy the ledgers and disrupt the network

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Border traders report that Gelt turned a raider's tribute chest into lead before its owner could hire an army.

Captured ledgers expose the foreign brokers supplying the raiders. The ledgers match the seals on several warehouses whose owners have been loudly proclaiming their innocence.

The council proposes that we buy the ledgers and disrupt the network. A second proposal would have us seize implicated goods. Gelt's latest lodgings stand empty, leaving his hosts to settle the accounts after his departure.

events.title: The Price of a Golden Statue
events.report: Temple stewards report that Gelt used a damaged ceremonial statue to demonstrate metalworking, leaving stronger fittings but a scandal over its altered appearance.

options.label: Pay for restoration while retaining the method
Let the temple claim the discovery

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Temple stewards report that Gelt used a damaged ceremonial statue to demonstrate metalworking, leaving stronger fittings but a scandal over its altered appearance. The stewards have submitted both the altered fittings and an itemized estimate for restoring the statue's ceremonial covering.

The council proposes that we pay for restoration while retaining the method. A second proposal would have us commission a scholarly explanation. No search party has persuaded the golden-masked visitor to remain for an audience.

events.title: The Salzenmund Trick
events.report: Your paymaster reports that the garrison's chest now contains lead coins. Witnesses saw a golden rider leaving the tower; unpaid soldiers are already gathering outside the treasury.

options.label: Delay payment and contain the disorder
Reorganize the garrison and acknowledge the sabotage

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our paymaster reports that the garrison's chest now contains lead coins. Witnesses saw a golden rider leaving the tower; unpaid soldiers are already gathering outside the treasury. The soldiers have broken open three further chests, and every supposedly golden coin has yielded beneath a knife.

One course would be to replace the payroll. Alternatively, we could delay payment and contain the disorder. Gelt has left his instruments packed for another journey, and the escort cannot promise to detain him.

events.title: The Arsenal's Soft Teeth
events.report: An ordnance inspection finds cannon fittings softened beyond use after Gelt entered the occupied foundry in disguise. He has fled through a service passage known to the former workers.

options.label: Salvage the metal and suspend operations

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. An ordnance inspection finds cannon fittings softened beyond use after Gelt entered the occupied foundry in disguise. He has fled through a service passage known to the former workers. The master gunner refuses to fire another piece until the weakened collars have been replaced or individually examined.

One course would be to purchase replacement fittings. Alternatively, we could salvage the metal and suspend operations. The masked alchemist has slipped away from the officials sent to demand an explanation.

events.title: A Bounty in False Gold
events.report: Your governor reports that agents bribed to locate Gelt accepted coins that reverted to lead. Their furious informants have exposed several government safe houses.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our governor reports that agents bribed to locate Gelt accepted coins that reverted to lead.

Their furious informants have exposed several government safe houses. Two frightened couriers have abandoned their lodgings after finding the exposed addresses posted outside a counting house.

One course would be to reimburse the network. Alternatively, we could abandon the compromised contacts. The remaining attendants expect Gelt to be across the border before any summons can reach him.

events.title: Windows of Brass
events.report: The occupation commandant reports that Gelt sealed a requisitioned laboratory in metal while prisoners escaped through its cellar. The frightened garrison has damaged adjoining houses trying to break in.

options.label: Abandon the building and restore discipline

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. The occupation commandant reports that Gelt sealed a requisitioned laboratory in metal while prisoners escaped through its cellar. The frightened garrison has damaged adjoining houses trying to break in. A smith has scraped a sample from the sealed door, but ordinary chisels have only spread cracks through its supporting wall.

One course would be to pay specialist smiths. Alternatively, we could force a breach. Gelt's latest lodgings stand empty, leaving his hosts to settle the accounts after his departure.

events.title: A Foundry's Silent Strike
events.report: Your inspector discovers that Gelt left apprentices instructions for quietly ruining military castings. The apprentices have disappeared, and the foundry's next delivery must be condemned.

options.label: Suspend casting and audit every mould

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our inspector discovers that Gelt left apprentices instructions for quietly ruining military castings. The apprentices have disappeared, and the foundry's next delivery must be condemned. The rejected castings bear the correct inspection stamps, making it impossible to distinguish safe deliveries by their paperwork alone.

One course would be to recall and replace the shipment. Alternatively, we could suspend casting and audit every mould. No search party has persuaded the golden-masked visitor to remain for an audience.

events.title: The Diplomatic Gift
events.report: Your chamberlain reports that an impressive gold gift brought by Gelt has reverted during an audience. Foreign guests witnessed the humiliation before the wizard escaped from his lodgings.
events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our chamberlain reports that an impressive gold gift brought by Gelt has reverted during an audience. Foreign guests witnessed the humiliation before the wizard escaped from his lodgings. The chamberlain has recovered the crumbling presentation tray, but every guest has already seen the dull metal beneath the gilding.

Our advisers recommend that we compensate offended guests. There is also a proposal to admit the deception. Gelt has left his instruments packed for another journey, and the escort cannot promise to detain him.

events.title: Mercenaries Without Masters
events.report: A frontier commander reports that Gelt transmuted the advance payment for imported mercenaries. The company is threatening to loot the district before marching away.

options.label: Cancel the commission and reorganize the garrison

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. A frontier commander reports that Gelt transmuted the advance payment for imported mercenaries.

The company is threatening to loot the district before marching away. The company's quartermaster has delivered a demand for payment together with the lead bars that replaced its promised advance.

Our advisers recommend that we pay the company again. There is also a proposal to cancel the commission and reorganize the garrison. The masked alchemist has slipped away from the officials sent to demand an explanation.

events.title: The Golden Sluice
events.report: Mine officers report that Gelt fused a drainage mechanism while helping captives escape. Water is rising through the lower workings, and the fugitive has crossed the outer cordon.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Mine officers report that Gelt fused a drainage mechanism while helping captives escape. Water is rising through the lower workings, and the fugitive has crossed the outer cordon. Miners have marked the rising water against the gallery posts, and the lowest pump can no longer be reached safely.

Our advisers recommend that we hire foreign pumps. There is also a proposal to abandon the flooded galleries. The remaining attendants expect Gelt to be across the border before any summons can reach him.

events.title: An Embassy of Ash
events.report: An official searching Gelt's abandoned workshop triggered a dangerous residue. The explosion destroyed seized military papers and spread panic through the administrative quarter.
events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. An official searching Gelt's abandoned workshop triggered a dangerous residue. The explosion destroyed seized military papers and spread panic through the administrative quarter. Clerks are drying the surviving pages in a neighbouring courtyard while displaced households queue beside the same temporary office.

Our advisers recommend that we fund relief and replace records. There is also a proposal to isolate the quarter. Gelt's latest lodgings stand empty, leaving his hosts to settle the accounts after his departure.

events.title: The Merchant's Last Lesson
events.report: Your trade commissioner reports that Gelt publicly demonstrated the adulteration of state-issued coinage, then disappeared. Merchants are refusing the next tax payment in that currency.

options.label: Exchange suspect coins at a loss

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our trade commissioner reports that Gelt publicly demonstrated the adulteration of state-issued coinage, then disappeared. Merchants are refusing the next tax payment in that currency. The merchants have brought their own scales to the counting house and are testing every official payment before accepting it.

Our advisers recommend that we exchange suspect coins at a loss. There is also a proposal to impose a temporary accounting settlement. No search party has persuaded the golden-masked visitor to remain for an audience.

events.title: The Scar of Finuval
events.report: Your wardens report that Teclis broke a lingering hostile enchantment at an old battlefield. Fragments of its design offer rare lessons, but pilgrims are entering the still-dangerous site.

options.label: Close the site for scholarly study
Pay veteran wardens to train our officers at the site

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our wardens report that Teclis broke a lingering hostile enchantment at an old battlefield.

Fragments of its design offer rare lessons, but pilgrims are entering the still-dangerous site. The wardens have fenced the broken inscriptions with rope, but pilgrims continue to slip through seeking fragments of the defeated spell.

We could authorize our officials to close the site for scholarly study. The competing request is to consecrate a safe memorial. The Elf has left his conclusions in writing rather than wait upon another court debate.

events.title: Students from the Human Lands
events.report: A harbour officer reports that Teclis admitted visiting human apprentices to a private lesson despite objections from local tutors. Their demonstrations have revealed mistakes in the province's teaching manuals.

options.label: Restrict attendance but retain the findings

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. A harbour officer reports that Teclis admitted visiting human apprentices to a private lesson despite objections from local tutors. Their demonstrations have revealed mistakes in the province's teaching manuals. The pupils' corrected exercises show that the disputed lesson exposed a real flaw rather than merely insulting established masters.

events.title: A Daemon's Broken Idol

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our local governor reports that Harald shattered a daemon's material anchor during a clash outside town. The liberated workshops still contain tribute and useful tools. The workshop masters have identified their confiscated tools among the rubble surrounding the shattered idol.

The council proposes that we return tools to their owners. A second proposal would have us inspect the remains under guard. The surviving scouts refuse to promise that any escort could compel the hammerer to remain.

events.title: The Cemetery's Empty Watch
events.report: Your magistrate reports that the graveyard's walking sentries collapsed after Harald passed through. Families are asking permission to recover remains previously held for ransom by a rogue keeper.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our magistrate reports that the graveyard's walking sentries collapsed after Harald passed through. Families are asking permission to recover remains previously held for ransom by a rogue keeper. The keeper's fee ledger names households that paid repeatedly without ever receiving permission to bury their relatives.

The council proposes that we permit supervised burials. A second proposal would have us seize the keeper's accumulated fees. His followers are already gathering their trophies for the next march.

events.title: The Foreign Barrow's Warning
events.report: Excavators report that Harald fought through a night of awakened skeletons after their survey breached a barrow. The surviving tablets describe safer routes through neighbouring ruins.

options.label: Have officers record and practise the cleared approach
Charge merchants for access to the cleared outer chambers

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Excavators report that Harald fought through a night of awakened skeletons after their survey breached a barrow.

The surviving tablets describe safer routes through neighbouring ruins. The excavators have copied the warning marks onto a plan of the outer chambers before the original tablets deteriorate further.

The council proposes that we translate the tablets. A second proposal would have us have officers record and practise the cleared approach. Harald has shown no interest in waiting while officials settle the consequences of his passage.

events.title: A Hammer at the Toll Road
events.report: A caravan captain reports that Harald killed a monstrous toll-collector and walked away without claiming the toll chest. Several settlements now petition over the recovered payments.

options.label: Return verified payments and restore the damaged waystation
Pay and recruit a new body of road wardens

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. A caravan captain reports that Harald killed a monstrous toll-collector and walked away without claiming the toll chest. Several settlements now petition over the recovered payments. Several toll receipts remain inside the chest, allowing at least some of the recovered money to be returned to its owners.

The council proposes that we return verified payments and restore the damaged waystation. A second proposal would have us pay and recruit a new body of road wardens. The last report places the hammerer on a road leading beyond our patrols.

events.title: Bones at the Northern Gate
events.report: Your necromantic commander reports that Harald destroyed the dead guarding a northern gate. The surviving attendants fled when creatures supposedly incapable of fear turned and ran.
events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our necromantic commander reports that Harald destroyed the dead guarding a northern gate. The surviving attendants fled when creatures supposedly incapable of fear turned and ran. The attendants have collected the guard's scattered weapons, but the spirits that once animated their bearers no longer answer.

One course would be to rebuild the guard. Alternatively, we could redirect other forces. Harald has moved on in search of another worthy opponent.

events.title: The Shrine's Shattered Champion
events.report: Your governor reports that Harald killed the champion defending a newly established occupation shrine. Local warriors are circulating the story as proof that your protection is hollow.
events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our governor reports that Harald killed the champion defending a newly established occupation shrine. Local warriors are circulating the story as proof that our protection is hollow. The champion's shattered insignia has been carried through nearby camps by witnesses eager to describe the defeat.

One course would be to replace the champion's retinue. Alternatively, we could reorganize the defence. The surviving scouts refuse to promise that any escort could compel the hammerer to remain.

events.title: The Barrow We Reopened
events.report: Your excavators awakened an ancient garrison and then watched Harald destroy it along with their equipment. The dig has collapsed and the survivors refuse to return.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our excavators awakened an ancient garrison and then watched Harald destroy it along with their equipment.

The dig has collapsed and the survivors refuse to return. The survey stakes disappear beneath fallen stone, and the survivors cannot even recover the tools needed to reopen the entrance.

One course would be to pay a new survey team. Alternatively, we could seal the site permanently. His followers are already gathering their trophies for the next march.

events.title: The Night Watch's Last Horn
events.report: The last survivors of your patrol report that Harald pursued them through an ancestral ruin after they tried to arrest him. Their equipment remains scattered among freshly smashed tombs.
events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. The last survivors of our patrol report that Harald pursued them through an ancestral ruin after they tried to arrest him. Their equipment remains scattered among freshly smashed tombs. The patrol's last horn was recovered from the threshold, broken where its bearer fell during the retreat.

One course would be to recover and replace equipment. Alternatively, we could discontinue patrols through the ruin. Harald has shown no interest in waiting while officials settle the consequences of his passage.

events.title: A Hammer Against Our Oath
events.report: Your occupation captain reports that Harald defeated an officer who claimed the local tribes had submitted willingly. The officer survived, but the public challenge has undermined your agreements.
events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our occupation captain reports that Harald defeated an officer who claimed the local tribes had submitted willingly. The officer survived, but the public challenge has undermined our agreements. Several tribal spokesmen now insist that their supposed pledges be read aloud and renewed before another levy is collected.

One course would be to renegotiate the pledges. Alternatively, we could buy renewed loyalty. The last report places the hammerer on a road leading beyond our patrols.

events.title: A Procession of Empty Armour
events.report: Your court receives a report that Harald smashed an undead ceremonial escort in full view of the population. Its attendants fled, leaving the state's sacred insignia trampled in the road.
events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our court receives a report that Harald smashed an undead ceremonial escort in full view of the population. Its attendants fled, leaving the state's sacred insignia trampled in the road. The procession's discarded standards have been recovered by street traders, who demand payment before returning them to the attendants.

Our advisers recommend that we restore the procession at expense. There is also a proposal to suspend ceremonies and reorganize security. Harald has moved on in search of another worthy opponent.

events.title: The Foreign Fort's Broken Hero
events.report: Your commander reports that Harald killed the champion stationed at an isolated fort. The remaining soldiers abandoned their outer post rather than accept his next challenge.
events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our commander reports that Harald killed the champion stationed at an isolated fort.

The remaining soldiers abandoned their outer post rather than accept his next challenge. The fort's officers have withdrawn the outer watch to the inner gate, leaving a stretch of road unpatrolled.

Our advisers recommend that we hire replacements. There is also a proposal to retrain the garrison. The surviving scouts refuse to promise that any escort could compel the hammerer to remain.

events.title: A Tomb Opened for Tribute
events.report: Officials excavating a tomb to collect valuables report that Harald fought its awakened defenders until both treasury chambers and survey camp were ruined. He has already left the district.

options.label: Rehouse the workers and repair the road

events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Officials excavating a tomb to collect valuables report that Harald fought its awakened defenders until both treasury chambers and survey camp were ruined. He has already left the district. The surviving excavators have submitted a list of the tools lost beneath the collapsed treasury chambers.

Our advisers recommend that we rehouse the workers and repair the road. There is also a proposal to abandon the site. His followers are already gathering their trophies for the next march.

events.title: The Spirit That Could Not Return
events.report: Your necromancer reports that a bound guardian struck by Harald cannot be summoned again. Its disappearance has exposed a route previously considered secure.
events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our necromancer reports that a bound guardian struck by Harald cannot be summoned again. Its disappearance has exposed a route previously considered secure. The necromancer has repeated the binding three times without response and finally requests guards who can walk to their posts unaided.

Our advisers recommend that we purchase mundane guards. There is also a proposal to redesign the defences. Harald has shown no interest in waiting while officials settle the consequences of his passage.

events.title: The Tournament's Uninvited Guest
events.report: Your herald reports that Harald entered a provincial martial display, defeated its champion, and escaped before the guards closed the field. Foreign observers are asking whether the result will be acknowledged.
events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our herald reports that Harald entered a provincial martial display, defeated its champion, and escaped before the guards closed the field. Foreign observers are asking whether the result will be acknowledged. The herald's official score sheet contradicts the account already sent to the visiting observers by their own attendants.

Our advisers recommend that we recognize the result. There is also a proposal to compensate the defeated company. The last report places the hammerer on a road leading beyond our patrols.

events.title: The Palace Steps Remember
events.report: Your custodians report that Abhorash defended workers restoring an ancient palace stair against tomb predators. His terse corrections to their inscription contradict the official account of Lahmia's fall.

options.label: Preserve his testimony alongside the old account
Honour the rescued workers and rebuild their homes

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our custodians report that Abhorash defended workers restoring an ancient palace stair against tomb predators.

His terse corrections to their inscription contradict the official account of Lahmia's fall. The custodians have preserved the damaged inscription beside a fresh copy of the corrections dictated by their unexpected defender.

We could authorize our officials to preserve his testimony alongside the old account. The competing request is to honour the rescued workers and rebuild their homes. The swordsman left before the local officers could arrange an audience.

events.title: The Prisoner He Would Not Yield
events.report: Your governor reports that Abhorash defeated a dangerous vampire but refused to surrender the captive to a sorcerer claiming authority over her. Their abandoned correspondence exposes a local coercion network.
events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our governor reports that Abhorash defeated a dangerous vampire but refused to surrender the captive to a sorcerer claiming authority over her. Their abandoned correspondence exposes a local coercion network. The abandoned letters name intermediaries who collected payments for threats the defeated vampire was supposed to enforce.

We could authorize our officials to investigate the network. The competing request is to accept a negotiated departure. No witness believes the stranger would accept confinement while the court debates his actions.

events.title: Blood Beyond Hunger
events.report: A physician brings observations left by Abhorash after he slew a dangerous scaled beast. He rejected ordinary tribute and warned against mistaking his ancient triumph over hunger for an easily repeated cure.

options.label: Preserve the remains as a trophy
Recruit the guides and circulate their hunting methods

events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. A physician brings observations left by Abhorash after he slew a dangerous scaled beast. He rejected ordinary tribute and warned against mistaking his ancient triumph over hunger for an easily repeated cure. The physician has sealed the samples separately from the hunters' trophies to discourage anyone from testing the blood on themselves.

We could authorize our officials to fund cautious study. The competing request is to preserve the remains as a trophy. Abhorash has taken no payment that could oblige him to remain in our service.

events.title: The Last Gate of Lahmia
events.report: Your garrison commander reports that Abhorash held a breach until civilians escaped a collapsing ruin. Survivors compare the rescue with his doomed defence of ancient Lahmia.

options.label: Instruct the guard from the account

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our garrison commander reports that Abhorash held a breach until civilians escaped a collapsing ruin. Survivors compare the rescue with his doomed defence of ancient Lahmia. The last families escaped carrying the wounded through a passage whose entrance the defenders had believed impossible to hold.

We could authorize our officials to repair the escape route. The competing request is to instruct the guard from the account. The swordsman's hosts found his quarters empty when they returned with the governor's summons.

events.title: A Duel Without Feeding
events.report: A local champion returns defeated but alive after challenging Abhorash. The stranger refused the customary payment and left a demanding schedule of exercises for anyone seeking another contest.

options.label: Keep the instructions within the guard

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. A local champion returns defeated but alive after challenging Abhorash.

The stranger refused the customary payment and left a demanding schedule of exercises for anyone seeking another contest. The defeated champion has copied the exercises for his own officers rather than conceal the manner of his defeat.

We could authorize our officials to adopt supervised training. The competing request is to honour restraint publicly. Abhorash has refused a position at court and continued his wandering.

events.title: The Dragon's Empty Lair
events.report: Your scouts report that Abhorash killed a dangerous drake and departed without taking its hoard. His followers insist the deed recalls his victory over a true dragon, but cannot promise miraculous properties in the remains.

options.label: Pay the guides’ settlements to rebuild their homes

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our scouts report that Abhorash killed a dangerous drake and departed without taking its hoard. His followers insist the deed recalls his victory over a true dragon, but cannot promise miraculous properties in the remains. The scouts have placed guards over the abandoned valuables while guides from the threatened settlements identify what was stolen from them.

Our officials ask us to secure and distribute the hoard. Others argue that we should instead fund anatomical study. The swordsman left before the local officers could arrange an audience.

events.title: A Captive Claimed by Two Courts
events.report: Your magistrate reports that Abhorash defeated a visiting vampire and prevented another sorcerer from taking custody. Their dispute spilled confidential letters into your officials' hands.

options.label: Broker a settlement from the letters

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our magistrate reports that Abhorash defeated a visiting vampire and prevented another sorcerer from taking custody. Their dispute spilled confidential letters into our officials' hands. Both claimants used the same local intermediaries, leaving enough correspondence to reconstruct their concealed arrangements.

Our officials ask us to broker a settlement from the letters. Others argue that we should instead expose the coercive bargain. No witness believes the stranger would accept confinement while the court debates his actions.

events.title: The Foreign City's Stair
events.report: Refugees report that Abhorash held a palace stair while a marauding force searched for captives. He left after the evacuation, refusing an invitation to take command.

options.label: Recruit the rescued volunteers and circulate his defence

events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Refugees report that Abhorash held a palace stair while a marauding force searched for captives. He left after the evacuation, refusing an invitation to take command. The refugees have brought intact tools and household possessions through the defended stair, giving them a chance to begin again.

Our officials ask us to settle the survivors. Others argue that we should instead recruit the rescued volunteers and circulate his defence. Abhorash has taken no payment that could oblige him to remain in our service.

events.title: The Swordsman's Unpaid Lesson
events.report: Your guard captain admits that a stranger defeated his best officers, then showed them how their formation failed. Witnesses identify Abhorash, who has already continued his journey.

options.label: Pay for the officers to teach others
Preserve the account as a training text

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our guard captain admits that a stranger defeated his best officers, then showed them how their formation failed.

Witnesses identify Abhorash, who has already continued his journey. The guard captain has marked the stranger's corrections on his formation chart and signed an account admitting his own errors.

Our officials ask us to pay for the officers to teach others. Others argue that we should instead preserve the account as a training text. The swordsman's hosts found his quarters empty when they returned with the governor's summons.

events.title: The Shrine of a False Dragon
events.report: Temple officials report that Abhorash exposed a charlatan selling a supposed cure for vampiric hunger. He destroyed the fraudulent draughts but left evidence of the sellers' wider network.
events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Temple officials report that Abhorash exposed a charlatan selling a supposed cure for vampiric hunger. He destroyed the fraudulent draughts but left evidence of the sellers' wider network. Several purchasers have surrendered unopened bottles, while the temple keeps the false remedy's account books under seal.

Our officials ask us to prosecute the fraud. Others argue that we should instead refund victims from seized funds. Abhorash has refused a position at court and continued his wandering.

events.title: The Steps We Could Not Hold
events.report: Your occupation commander reports that Abhorash cut through the palace guard and led captives out by an ancient stair. The attack has revived stories of Lahmia's defence among the inhabitants.
events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our occupation commander reports that Abhorash cut through the palace guard and led captives out by an ancient stair. The attack has revived stories of Lahmia's defence among the inhabitants. The surviving guards have abandoned the lower stair, allowing local residents to carry the rescued prisoners away before reinforcements arrive.

The council proposes that we rebuild and reinforce the guard. A second proposal would have us relinquish the exposed palace quarter. The swordsman left before the local officers could arrange an audience.

events.title: The Sorcerer's Refused Demand
events.report: Your envoy reports that Abhorash defeated your escort after it tried to seize a vampire under his protection. The prisoner escaped, and the papers authorizing the seizure are now public.

options.label: Negotiate an end to the dispute

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our envoy reports that Abhorash defeated our escort after it tried to seize a vampire under his protection. The prisoner escaped, and the papers authorizing the seizure are now public. Copies of the seizure order now bear witnesses' descriptions of the defeated escort beside the envoy's official seal.

The council proposes that we negotiate an end to the dispute. A second proposal would have us compensate the escort's families. No witness believes the stranger would accept confinement while the court debates his actions.

events.title: An Empty Beast Pen
events.report: Your beast-master reports that Abhorash killed a prized draconic creature in single combat. He ignored the treasury beside its pen, making the loss look like judgement rather than robbery.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our beast-master reports that Abhorash killed a prized draconic creature in single combat.

He ignored the treasury beside its pen, making the loss look like judgement rather than robbery. The surviving handlers have locked the empty pen and submitted the purchase records to demonstrate the value of the loss.

The council proposes that we import another military beast. A second proposal would have us replace its role with troops. Abhorash has taken no payment that could oblige him to remain in our service.

events.title: The Challenge on the Gate
events.report: Your governor finds the garrison champion's broken weapon hung above the city gate. Abhorash spared the defeated soldiers but left a demand that prisoners be treated honourably.

options.label: Review the disputed judgment and meet his demand
Pay for a new guard establishment

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our governor finds the garrison champion's broken weapon hung above the city gate. Abhorash spared the defeated soldiers but left a demand that prisoners be treated honourably. Families of the released prisoners have gathered below the broken weapon, demanding that the stranger's warning be obeyed.

The council proposes that we review the disputed judgment and meet his demand. A second proposal would have us pay for a new guard establishment. The swordsman's hosts found his quarters empty when they returned with the governor's summons.

events.title: The Collector of Blood
events.report: Your tax officer reports that Abhorash scattered an armed collection party abusing local households. Its ledgers were left with the victims, who now demand repayment.
events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our tax officer reports that Abhorash scattered an armed collection party abusing local households. Its ledgers were left with the victims, who now demand repayment. The households have compared the seized ledgers with their own receipts, producing a list of payments they expect returned.

The council proposes that we repay the disputed levy. A second proposal would have us investigate the collectors. Abhorash has refused a position at court and continued his wandering.

events.title: The Champion's Last Salute
events.report: Your herald reports that Abhorash killed a celebrated officer in an openly witnessed duel. The officer's companions escaped unharmed and insist that their ruler honour the result.
events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our herald reports that Abhorash killed a celebrated officer in an openly witnessed duel. The officer's companions escaped unharmed and insist that their ruler honour the result. The officer's companions have returned his broken sword and insist that no ambush or treachery caused his death.

One course would be to acknowledge the duel. Alternatively, we could fund a state funeral. The swordsman left before the local officers could arrange an audience.

events.title: A Dragon Sold Too Soon
events.report: Your merchant-agent reports that Abhorash slew the drake bought for your army before delivery. The contract is enforceable, and the creature's remains are worth much less than the promised weapon.
events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our merchant-agent reports that Abhorash slew the drake bought for our army before delivery.

The contract is enforceable, and the creature's remains are worth much less than the promised weapon. The merchant has presented the signed delivery terms together with an estimate of the much smaller sum the carcass might fetch.

One course would be to pay the contract. Alternatively, we could renegotiate under threat of scandal. No witness believes the stranger would accept confinement while the court debates his actions.

events.title: The Fugitive He Protected
events.report: Your prison commander reports that Abhorash took a captive vampire from a sorcerer's escort after defeating its guards. Neither fugitive remains in the province, and the escort's allies demand answers.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our prison commander reports that Abhorash took a captive vampire from a sorcerer's escort after defeating its guards. Neither fugitive remains in the province, and the escort's allies demand answers. The defeated escort has returned with empty restraints and conflicting instructions from the sorcerer who claimed the captive.

One course would be to settle their claims. Alternatively, we could investigate the escort's secret orders. Abhorash has taken no payment that could oblige him to remain in our service.

events.title: The Foreign Palace Breach
events.report: Your governor reports that Abhorash opened a route through the palace guard during a mass escape. The surviving soldiers refuse to pursue him into the ruins beyond the city.

options.label: Restore the guard's equipment and pay

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our governor reports that Abhorash opened a route through the palace guard during a mass escape. The surviving soldiers refuse to pursue him into the ruins beyond the city. The gate's outer hinges were cut during the escape, and the quartermaster cannot secure the compound with the remaining guard.

One course would be to restore the guard's equipment and pay. Alternatively, we could abandon the outer compound. The swordsman's hosts found his quarters empty when they returned with the governor's summons.

events.title: The Trophy He Left Behind
events.report: A provincial noble presented Abhorash with captives as a reward for killing a monster. Your officials now report the captives freed and the noble publicly defeated before the entire court.

options.label: Compensate those harmed by the noble

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. A provincial noble presented Abhorash with captives as a reward for killing a monster. Our officials now report the captives freed and the noble publicly defeated before the entire court. The freed captives have given matching accounts of the presentation, leaving the noble unable to dismiss the humiliation as private gossip.

One course would be to compensate those harmed by the noble. Alternatively, we could remove his office. Abhorash has refused a position at court and continued his wandering.

events.title: The Tower's Returned Reliquary
events.report: Your cemetery keeper reports that Elspeth recovered a stolen funerary relic and identified a dangerous error in its inscription. She returned to her tower before officials could question her methods.

options.label: Correct the burial register and rites

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Our cemetery keeper reports that Elspeth recovered a stolen funerary relic and identified a dangerous error in its inscription.

She returned to her tower before officials could question her methods. The keeper has copied the faulty line beside Elspeth's correction so that the same mistake need not be repeated at future burials.

Our advisers recommend that we correct the burial register and rites. There is also a proposal to commission a guarded study. The Amethyst visitor has closed her temporary refuge and prepared to depart.

events.title: Rawbones in the Reed Beds
events.report: Your marsh patrol brings remains of a monstrous corpse-heap destroyed by Elspeth. Witnesses compare it to Rawbones, while nearby villagers demand the blocked waterways be cleared.

options.label: Sell surplus baggage and equip willing patrol recruits

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our marsh patrol brings remains of a monstrous corpse-heap destroyed by Elspeth. Witnesses compare it to Rawbones, while nearby villagers demand the blocked waterways be cleared. Reeds and broken bones have lodged around the mill sluice, while patrolmen keep curious villagers away from the largest remains.

Our advisers recommend that we restore the waterways. There is also a proposal to study the creature safely. Elspeth has left a written warning in place of an audience and moved beyond the local watch.

events.title: The Lady Behind the Mirror
events.report: Your court clerk reports that Elspeth exposed a vampire intermediary using borrowed identities. The intruder escaped her first trap, but abandoned letters reveal a network resembling Vashara's methods.
events.description:
Witnesses from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have brought their account before our officials. Our court clerk reports that Elspeth exposed a vampire intermediary using borrowed identities. The intruder escaped her first trap, but abandoned letters reveal a network resembling Vashara's methods. The clerk has matched several false names to gifts still held by officials who deny ever meeting the same visitor twice.

Our advisers recommend that we investigate the correspondents. There is also a proposal to quietly reverse the bargains. No officer has persuaded the wizard to remain while the surviving papers are examined.

events.title: The Witch Hunters' Silence
events.report: Your magistrate reports that hunters who forced their way into Elspeth's refuge returned alive but unable to explain what they saw. They left recovered criminal evidence and a dispute over jurisdiction.

options.label: Review their mandate and use the evidence
Reward the useful discovery without endorsing the intrusion

events.description:
Our officials in [war_adventurer_province.GetName] have forwarded the following account. Our magistrate reports that hunters who forced their way into Elspeth's refuge returned alive but unable to explain what they saw. They left recovered criminal evidence and a dispute over jurisdiction. The hunters will discuss the recovered evidence, but none will volunteer to lead another search of the refuge.

Our advisers recommend that we review their mandate and use the evidence. There is also a proposal to broker limits on future searches. Elspeth has withdrawn from the officials sent to question her and will pursue her own investigations elsewhere.

events.title: The Champion's Black Talisman
events.report: Your military council receives a survivor's account of a warded champion who died when an enemy tried to possess his body. Elspeth's talisman destroyed the intruder, leaving the council both a defence to study and a family to compensate.

options.label: Have officers and scholars study the ward’s preparation

events.description:
A courier from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has delivered testimony and a request for instructions. Our military council receives a survivor's account of a warded champion who died when an enemy tried to possess his body.

Elspeth's talisman destroyed the intruder, leaving the council both a defence to study and a family to compensate. The champion's surviving attendant has brought the broken talisman together with the family's petition for support.

Our advisers recommend that we have officers and scholars study the ward’s preparation. There is also a proposal to fund the champion's dependants. Her attendants have offered no promise that the wizard will remain within reach of our messengers.

events.title: A Tower in Another Language
events.report: Local scholars report that Elspeth opened a sealed archive and removed a lethal curse before departing with one disputed object. Her remaining notes explain several previously unreadable inscriptions.

options.label: Settle ownership claims and restore the archive
Keep the knowledge within the court

events.description:
A sealed report from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] has reached our court. Local scholars report that Elspeth opened a sealed archive and removed a lethal curse before departing with one disputed object. Her remaining notes explain several previously unreadable inscriptions. The remaining shelves contain legible catalogues, giving local scholars their first reliable guide to what the sealed archive once held.

We could authorize our officials to translate and publish the notes. The competing request is to settle ownership claims and restore the archive. The Amethyst visitor has closed her temporary refuge and prepared to depart.

events.title: The Marsh's Borrowed Dead
events.report: Your governor reports that Elspeth dismantled a shambling mass of stolen corpses outside a foreign burial ground. Families seek their remains while officials argue over who pays for identification.

options.label: Fund honourable burials and rebuild the survivors’ homes
Study the binding method under guard

events.description:
The latest dispatch from [war_adventurer_province.GetName] describes an incident demanding our attention. Our governor reports that Elspeth dismantled a shambling mass of stolen corpses outside a foreign burial ground. Families seek their remains while officials argue over who pays for identification. Burial attendants have separated recognizable belongings from the remains, allowing several families to identify those they lost.

We could authorize our officials to fund honourable burials and rebuild the survivors’ homes. The competing request is to recover the desecrators' property. Elspeth has left a written warning in place of an audience and moved beyond the local watch.

events.title: A Diplomat with No Reflection
events.report: Your chamberlain receives Elspeth's evidence that a charming visitor has been enthralling officials. The visitor fled, leaving gifts that can be reclaimed once their enchantments are removed.
